attestations.note: The life page heads «Τύπος εορτής: Σταθερή. Εορτάζει στις 11 Δεκεμβρίου εκάστου έτους», the same day as the listing. It names its witness plainly — the memory is recorded only in the Lavriote Codex B 4, folio 133, where there is also a full service with canons, published by L. Petit in the Byzantinische Zeitschrift 13 (1904), pages 398 to 420, and by Dmitrievsky at Kyiv in 1911. That is a single manuscript witness named, not the site's own mark of doubt: there is no asterisk and no «Δεν είναι διασταυρωμένη» sentence. The corpus's `types` vocabulary has no word for an emperor, so `king` is used and the title is carried in `office`; that is a question for the author. The page prints none of the service it mentions, so no hymn is drafted. His help to Athanasius the Athonite in building the Great Lavra is the page's own statement and is the ground of the `related` row.
